CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

4. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

5. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

6. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

7. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.

8. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Handball.
   B. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Handball.
   D. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   B. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

11. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Handball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Storytelling and Animation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

3. B — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. B — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — The speed of the music

11. D — Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. B — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
